                                                                                    Annexure-II

Dynacons Secures the Project worth Rs 137.15 crores (inclusive of GST) from Supreme Court of
India for supply, installation, testing & commissioning of 728 Servers along with requisite cables,
accessories at 728 District Courts of Indian Judiciary, PAN India for hosting the existing Case
Information System (CIS) software of the District Courts.


The solution is to primarily host the existing Case Information System (CIS) software of the
District Courts. The project is structured as a multi-year engagement with ongoing support for
a period of 3 years.

Project Overview

The scope of the project involves Supply, installation, testing and commissioning (SITC) of
Servers to be deployed across 728 District Court headquarters, provisioning of all software and
support for the entire contract period. The implementation includes server virtualization, high
availability & clustering, centralized management console & integration with existing ICT
infrastructure. The technical support will be provided for 24 x 7 x 365 for the solution provided
during the contract period of 3 years including remote & onsite support as required.
